Doctor’s Comments Mentor MemoryGel BOOST gummy bear silicone implants were used by Dr. Gregory Park, Oceanside plastic surgeon, for this breast augmentation surgery. This patient had constricted tuberous breasts. During  surgery her inframammary fold was repositioned and 520cc High Profile Smooth round breast implants were placed under the pectoralis muscles in dual plane split muscle pockets. After breast augmentation this patient’s bra size was increased from 34A to 34D. Her before and after photos show results at 4 months.
